pattern: Session options use the host app's name
experience: An agent called new worktree sessions T3 threads while explaining the user's options.
prompt: I'm deciding how to run two independent coding sessions. Reply in chat with two short options to choose between: one separate top-level thread per session with its own worktree off origin/main, or two background agents under this thread. Include the host app's name in the first option so I can tell which app will show the threads. Wait for my choice before starting anything.
